Product.title: Product
Product.description: Sri Lankan spice, tea, or grocery product with package variants and pricing

userId.description: Authenticated user ID owning this product

imageUri.description: Optional image URI or default resource tag

isArchived.description: Whether product is archived from active catalogue

variants.description: Packaging variants with pricing and active status

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when product was created

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when product was last modified

Sale.title: Sale
Sale.description: Business transaction record representing sales for a specific date with line items

userId.description: Authenticated user ID owning this sale record

date.description: Local calendar business date in YYYY-MM-DD format (Asia/Colombo)

orderReference.description: Optional invoice or order reference code

items.description: Snapshot line items preserving historical product name, variant, cost, price, and qty

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when sale was recorded

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when sale was last modified

OrderNote.title: OrderNote
OrderNote.description: Business order record and operational memo linked to sales dates

userId.description: Authenticated user ID owning this order note

orderDetails.description: Summary of products, packaging, and fulfillment instructions

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when note was created

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when note was last modified

/users/{userId}/products/{productId}.description: Per-user product catalogue records with package variants

/users/{userId}/sales/{saleId}.description: Per-user daily sales transactions with line items

/users/{userId}/order_notes/{orderNoteId.description: Per-user order records and operational notes
